status: offline draft implemented by main; independent design findings incorporated below; tests and non-author implementation review required before RPC
hypothesis: The first cold pinned-prefix request waits for source checks and then a completely determined account/storage hydration batch. Co-send these independent reads in one HTTP envelope, validate ALL three source checks before constructing/publishing any pinned values or executing EVM. No logical reads or checks removed.

evidence.qualification: Only one hydration HTTP exchange can be removed per cold source; warm prefix execution is already submillisecond. Not a full Solver latency proof.

eligible: Initially only source-pinned trialPrefix scalar request with no existing pinned session. Ordinary strict/final sim, legacy, warm session and paired paths retain existing behavior.
proposedInternals: Factor exact existing hydration address/slot planning and warm-batch request/result decoding into private helpers, used by both old and candidate paths; no protocol addresses/selectors/layout changes.

Prepare EIP-1898 hash-pinned hydration requests using validated sourcePin and empty cold slot/cache state. Combine with three unchanged source prechecks; use existing batch parsing, fatal and retry machinery.

Validate complete prechecks, canonical header, root and environment before constructing RemoteRevmDb, applying fetched values, setting slot hints or executing prefix. On mismatch discard every fetched value and preserve fatal precedence.

Apply pre-fetched responses with same existing hydration decoder exactly once; original strict_simulate_at may visit hydration again but must issue no duplicate RPC because same source values are present. No arbitrary response cache in RpcClient.

All postchecks remain fresh AFTER execution and every local request has isolated mutable EVM state. No source-attestation reuse, continuation cache, code overrides, amount/candidate/budget/config changes.

Fast path has a NEW private eligibility bound of 256 outgoing items including3 source checks, not a claimed existing provider limit. Larger requests use original two-batch path before any dispatch, never truncated.

resolvedDesignReview.decision: Accept bounded transport-grouping differences while preserving every fail-closed authority check; exact serial failure attribution is not an equivalence claim.
resolvedDesignReview.failurePrecedence: Existing send_json inspects all returned error items. Mixed invalid-source plus hydration-throttle remains fatal and may report throttle instead of the serial baseline's source fault. Never clear/suppress any fatal latch to restore a label.
resolvedDesignReview.readAccounting: Logical method/parameter multiset must match for successful no-retry requests. Invalid-source calls now co-issue hydration; combined transport retries resend both parts under unchanged retry limit/deadline. Count all physical attempts; no post-send fallback or enlarged deadline.
resolvedDesignReview.size: At most256items for this optimization only. This does not admit/drop/truncate requests or change the existing fallback's input limit.
resolvedDesignReview.semantics: All source checks must complete before values enter pinned cache or EVM. Full prefix/main/state source, successful outputs/gas/effects/attestations and fresh postcheck stay unchanged.
